name: links-manager
description: The Link Manager is a web application designed to help you save and manage all your favorite and important URLs in one convenient location. With a clean and intuitive interface, you can easily add, update, delete, and fetch links.

paragraphs: The Link Manager is a web application designed to help you save and manage all your favorite and important URLs in one convenient location. With a clean and intuitive interface, you can easily add, update, delete, and fetch links. The application also includes an advanced "Undo" feature, allowing you to recover accidentally deleted links. All data is securely stored in a MySQL database.
features: Add Links: Save your favorite and important URLs.
Update Links: Modify existing URLs and the name.
Delete Links: Remove URLs you no longer need.
Undo Deletion: Recover accidentally deleted links within a short time frame.
Fetch Links: Retrieve and display all your saved URLs.
